name: D. Odometry: strafe pod counts the other way
description: This robot's strafe (Y) pod is mounted the other way round from last season's robot, so the direction in the code is wrong. Program 5's Pinpoint Tuner finds it; until the programmer enters it, program 6 cannot pass.

faults.text: Strafe pod counts the other way (yPodDirection must be FORWARD)
